verdict.rationale: Render documents a custom domains feature and free TLS for every domain, including wildcards, which could support tenant subdomains. It also has a REST API with a published OpenAPI spec. Nothing in the evidence shows custom domains being added or routed through the API, or managed at multi-tenant scale. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for adding and verifying custom domains, per-tenant routing to services, limits on domains per service for SaaS use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can programmatically provision and route custom domains for my own multi-tenant SaaS customers

citations.quote: Free TLS certificates for every domain, including wildcards.
